title: Alan Fontus Third Meeting

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: The plumbing of destiny has returned you here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The plumbing of destiny has returned you here.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: Well, destiny is a fluid concept, and one you must not lean on, it lest you fall to your death.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, destiny is a fluid concept, and one you must not lean on, it lest you fall to your death.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: Once again, the words you spoke when last we met have grown like a slime mold within me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Once again, the words you spoke when last we met have grown like a slime mold within me.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: Have you ever come across a bad slime mold?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you ever come across a bad slime mold?

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: Help? Have you ever seen slime mold? Horrible stuff.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Help? Have you ever seen slime mold? Horrible stuff.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: My research is complete. Now we must decide what to do with it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My research is complete. Now we must decide what to do with it.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: Another perfect allegory for life... nearly as good as the plumbing one!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Another perfect allegory for life... nearly as good as the plumbing one!

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: My life's work has the power to change the way the wind blows. One man's eternal life, could be a society's eternal death.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My life's work has the power to change the way the wind blows. One man's eternal life, could be a society's eternal death.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: Yes, of course. You and I have some important choices to make. One man's eternal life could be a society's impending death.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, of course. You and I have some important choices to make. One man's eternal life could be a society's impending death.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: Your oversimplification of an over complication is clunky, but by and large, you are bang on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your oversimplification of an over complication is clunky, but by and large, you are bang on.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: I suspect you already have. In my two hundred and thirty years on this world, I have learned a lot about people. You are a person and people make choices every day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I suspect you already have. In my two hundred and thirty years on this world, I have learned a lot about people. You are a person and people make choices every day.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: No choice is ordinary.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No choice is ordinary.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: Give or take. I did lose track in the one hundred and sixties but we find our way back don't we? My research has been putting the train in front of the track as it were.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Give or take. I did lose track in the one hundred and sixties but we find our way back don't we? My research has been putting the train in front of the track as it were.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: Well, I'm not quite sure what we are talking about but you seem to know your stuff so I'll take that into consideration. Goodbye for now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I'm not quite sure what we are talking about but you seem to know your stuff so I'll take that into consideration. Goodbye for now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I was just passing through.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I was just passing through.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes, it must be destiny.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, it must be destiny.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll keep that in mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll keep that in mind.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is that a good thing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is that a good thing?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm glad I could help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm glad I could help.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How's the research?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How's the research?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thank you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you can make people immortal, and you don't know what to do with that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you can make people immortal, and you don't know what to do with that?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you can make people immortal, and you don't know what to do with that?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you can make people immortal, and you don't know what to do with that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How could I possibly help you make that choice?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How could I possibly help you make that choice?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How could I possibly help you make that choice?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How could I possibly help you make that choice?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're two hundred and thirty years old?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're two hundred and thirty years old?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're two hundred and thirty years old?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're two hundred and thirty years old?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This isn't an ordinary choice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This isn't an ordinary choice.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think this research would be terrible in the wrong hands. You should destroy it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think this research would be terrible in the wrong hands. You should destroy it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think this research would be terrible in the wrong hands. You should destroy it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think this research would be terrible in the wrong hands. You should destroy it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What an amazing feat! You should make your research public.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What an amazing feat! You should make your research public.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What an amazing feat! You should make your research public.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What an amazing feat! You should make your research public.
